question: Which city was the venue for the 2018 BRICS Foreign Ministers’ meeting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pretoria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2018 BRICS Foreign Ministers’ Meeting** was held in **Pretoria, South Africa**. This meeting was a precursor to the 10th BRICS Summit that took place later that year in Johannesburg.
 
• The **BRICS** group consists of five major emerging economies: **Brazil, Russia, India, China**, and **South Africa**. These nations collaborate on a range of political, economic, and cultural issues to foster mutual growth and understanding.
 
• The theme of the **2018 BRICS Summit** was **“BRICS in Africa: Collaboration for Inclusive Growth and Shared Prosperity in the 4th Industrial Revolution”**. This theme highlighted Africa's role in shaping the future of global development.
 
• The meeting in Pretoria provided an opportunity for BRICS Foreign Ministers to discuss global political challenges, strategies for economic growth, and ways to enhance cooperation among member nations.
 
• South Africa played a significant role in 2018 as the BRICS Chair, hosting multiple events and driving discussions on key topics such as **peacekeeping, sustainable development, and economic partnerships**.
 
• The venue, **Pretoria**, is the administrative capital of South Africa and a center for political decision-making in the country. It frequently hosts diplomatic events of international importance.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Pretoria.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About BRICS:**

 
 
• **BRICS** was established in **2009** as a platform for cooperation among some of the largest emerging economies. South Africa joined the group in **2010**, making it BRICS instead of BRIC.
 
• The organization aims to promote **peace, security, development, and cooperation** among its member countries and on a global scale.
 
• The group represents approximately **42% of the global population**, 23% of GDP, and 17% of world trade, making it a significant force in international relations.
 
 
 
• **Significance of South Africa in BRICS:**
 
 
• South Africa joined BRICS to represent the African continent, giving the group a more global representation and a stronger voice for developing nations.
 
• As the only African member, South Africa frequently brings attention to **issues affecting Africa**, such as poverty, inequality, and sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Other BRICS Cities:**
 
 
• **Beijing:** The capital of China, which frequently hosts major BRICS-related events due to its economic and political significance.
 
• **New Delhi:** India’s capital has also been a venue for BRICS meetings, showcasing its role as a key member of the group.
 
• **Moscow:** The capital of Russia, another founding member of BRICS, which often hosts summits and key discussions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **BRICS Summits:**

 
 
• The annual BRICS summits provide a platform for leaders to discuss pressing global and regional issues and formulate strategies for cooperation.
 
• Key areas of focus include **trade, investment, technology, sustainable development, and global peace.**
 
 
 
• **Role of Foreign Ministers’ Meetings:**
 
 
• These meetings prepare the groundwork for the annual summits by identifying key priorities and discussing potential challenges.
 
• The 2018 meeting in Pretoria was instrumental in shaping discussions for the 10th BRICS Summit held in Johannesburg.
